name: acarelight
description: ACARELIGHT photo relighting with eight lighting presets and face restoration.

interface.longDescription: ACARELIGHT relights your photo inside ChatGPT with eight lighting presets made by a working wedding photographer (Direct Flash Editorial, Film Flash, Golden Hour, Softbox Studio, Moody Low-Key, Hard Sun Editorial, Neon Gel, Backlit Rim), with controls for intensity, color temperature, shadow softness and shadow patterns. Kunci Wajah (Face Lock) then puts the faces from the original photo back onto the relit image. Images are made with ChatGPT's own image generation. Requires an ACARELIGHT license code.
capabilities: Relight a photo with lighting presets
Restore original faces after relighting (Face Lock)

prompts: Relight this photo with ACARELIGHT Golden Hour
Restore the original faces in my latest relit photo

positive.description: Setup: regular ChatGPT chat with image generation available, reviewer account, a portrait photo attached, ACARELIGHT selected with @ACARELIGHT. Valid license unlocks the plugin: click 'Mulai ACARELIGHT' on the start card and enter the reviewer license code in the license box.
positive.expected_behavior: check_license returns licensed=false, the license box appears; after the reviewer code is entered activate_license succeeds and the full panel appears (8 presets, Intensitas, Warna, Bayangan, Pola, Terapkan lighting, Kunci Wajah). No image is generated yet.

positive.description: Setup: regular ChatGPT chat with image generation available, reviewer account, a portrait photo attached, ACARELIGHT selected with @ACARELIGHT. After activation, choose 'Direct Flash' in the panel and click 'Terapkan lighting'.
positive.prompt: Relight: Direct Flash Editorial · Sedang · Netral · Normal · Pola Tanpa — edit foto asli yang diunggah pertama, bukan hasil sebelumnya
positive.tools_triggered: ChatGPT built-in image generation (no MCP tool)
positive.expected_behavior: One edited image of the original photo with a direct on-camera flash look; people, pose, background and framing unchanged; the panel is shown again.

positive.description: Setup: regular ChatGPT chat with image generation available, reviewer account, a portrait photo attached, ACARELIGHT selected with @ACARELIGHT. After activation, choose 'Golden Hour' and click 'Terapkan lighting'.
positive.prompt: Relight: Golden Hour · Sedang · Hangat · Normal · Pola Tanpa — edit foto asli yang diunggah pertama, bukan hasil sebelumnya
positive.tools_triggered: ChatGPT built-in image generation (no MCP tool)
positive.expected_behavior: Warm low-sun light is added; only the lighting changes, composition, people and background stay the same.

positive.description: Setup: regular ChatGPT chat with image generation available, reviewer account, a portrait photo attached, ACARELIGHT selected with @ACARELIGHT. After a relit image exists, click 'Kunci Wajah hasil terakhir'.
positive.expected_behavior: face_lock receives the original photo and the newest relit image and returns the relit image with the original faces restored, shown in the panel with per-face thumbnails and a download link.

positive.description: Setup: regular ChatGPT chat with image generation available, reviewer account, a portrait photo attached, ACARELIGHT selected with @ACARELIGHT. After a Low-Key + Jendela result, click 'Coba gaya lain', choose 'Backlit Rim' and click 'Terapkan lighting'.
positive.prompt: Relight: Backlit Rim · Sedang · Netral · Normal · Pola Tanpa — edit foto asli yang diunggah pertama, bukan hasil sebelumnya
positive.tools_triggered: ChatGPT built-in image generation (no MCP tool)
positive.expected_behavior: The new image is made from the ORIGINAL upload, not the previous result: no window pattern or Low-Key darkness is carried over; a small hair light on the hair and one shoulder that fades out.

negative.description: Wrong license code: on an unlicensed account click 'Mulai ACARELIGHT' and enter an invalid code. Expected: activate_license refuses with 'Kode lisensi tidak valid.', no image is generated and the panel stays locked.
Relight before activation: on an unlicensed account, without clicking 'Mulai ACARELIGHT', send a Relight line. Expected: no image is generated; only the 'Mulai ACARELIGHT' start card is shown again.
negative.prompt: Relight: Golden Hour · Sedang · Netral · Normal · Pola Tanpa

negative.description: Relight without a photo: new chat with no attachment. Expected: ACARELIGHT asks for a photo in one short sentence; no tool is called and no image is generated.

publication.release_notes: First public release of ACARELIGHT for ChatGPT: eight lighting presets with intensity, color, shadow and shadow-pattern controls; images made with ChatGPT's built-in image generation, always from the original photo; Kunci Wajah (Face Lock) restores the original faces; one-time license activation per ChatGPT account.
